cells.note: Rescored under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 58): The Data Protection Act 2021 sets conditions on transfers in sections 70 and 71 [ZMB-001], but it starts on a date the Minister appoints and none is held, so it counts as a draft and the stage is 2.
